subject: Re: OpenMetrics sprint — community credits request
messages:
From: Marisol Vega <marisol@openmetrics.dev>
To: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: organizers@pixelhack.org
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OpenMetrics summer sprint — request for community credits

Hi Alex,

Hope you’re well — I’m Marisol, one of the maintainers at the OpenMetrics Foundation. We’re organizing a week-long community sprint (Aug 3–7) tied to the PixelHack conference; last year ~300 contributors attended, and we expect ~450 this year.

We run workshops, mentor sessions, and a small grant pool for maintainers who need build/test credits. Would Redwood be able to offer a promotional credits package or trial extension to support:
- 20 maintainers with 10k token equivalents each for two weeks
- 3 demo VMs for workshop leads

Attached is our short proposal and schedule. Happy to discuss options — we’d like to publicize Redwood in the sponsor materials if we can secure a commitment by June 25.

Best,
Marisol Vega
Community Lead, OpenMetrics Foundation
https://openmetrics.dev

Attachment: openmetrics_summer_sprint_proposal.md (proposal deck, 1 page)

From: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Marisol Vega <marisol@openmetrics.dev>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OpenMetrics summer sprint — request for community credits

Hi Marisol — thanks for the note and the proposal. Congrats on the expected turnout — sounds great. Quick Qs before I loop in Partnerships/Finance:
1) Do maintainers need dedicated model endpoints or is a token grant sufficient?
2) Any legal/compliance requirements (SOC2, DPA) for contributors using paid resources?
3) Preferable activation window — you mentioned two weeks; do you need any pre-activated accounts for workshop leads?

We can probably put together a hybrid package: promotional tokens + a short trial extension for selected accounts, and a temporary promo code for participants. Laura, Rafael — can you weigh in on what level of credits we can authorize for a community sprint (and whether we want Redwood branding visibility in the sponsorship materials)?

If we can confirm the ask (tokens + number of dedicated endpoints), I’ll draft an approval summary for Finance.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Account Exec, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OpenMetrics summer sprint — request for community credits

Thanks Alex — quick read through the proposal attached. High level: this is the exact kind of community sponsorship Partnerships wants to back. A few operational notes:
- We can offer a "Community Sprint Pack": 20 x 10k-token grants (redeemable codes) + 3 dedicated demo endpoints for 2 weeks.
- Visibility: ask for Redwood logo on the sprint page + a 5-min demo slot during the opening session.
- We’ll require the maintainers to accept our standard promo terms (limit per account, no resale).

Rafael — can you confirm budget/discount authority? If this stays promotional (no firm financial credit), approvals are lightweight; if they request $ value on our balance sheet we need Finance sign-off.

Markus — tagging you given the potential overall exposure and any budget comments.

Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: credits_policy.pdf (internal promo terms, 3 pages)

From: rafael_mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OpenMetrics summer sprint — request for community credits

All — I’m comfortable approving the Community Sprint Pack as a marketing/promotional expense. Suggested parameters:
- 20 promo codes, 10k tokens each, expiring 30 days after activation.
- 3 dedicated demo endpoints (access-limited) for the week of Aug 3–7.
- Redwood logo + 5-min demo in exchange for the package.

Markus — can you give final sign-off on the allocation (we’ll record as a marketing sponsorship, HS-120341)? If approved we should create the codes and provide an activation guide to Marisol.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Sr. Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OpenMetrics summer sprint — request for community credits

Approved. Allocate as marketing sponsorship (no revenue impact).
- Generate 20 promo codes (10k tokens each) tied to HS-120341.
- Provision 3 demo endpoints in the sandbox org (limited to the sprint window).
- Laura: confirm Redwood branding materials by June 24 so we can include them in the sponsor kit.

Markus Klein
VP Finance & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Marisol Vega <marisol@openmetrics.dev>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OpenMetrics summer sprint — request for community credits

Hi Marisol — great news: Finance approved the Community Sprint Pack. Summary and next steps:
- What we’ll provide: 20 promo codes of 10,000 tokens each (redeemable by maintainers) + 3 demo endpoints provisioned Aug 3–7.
- Action items for OpenMetrics: please share a final list of maintainers (names + emails) who will receive codes by July 20; provide the sponsor logo files by June 24 for the sponsor page.
- Operational: we’ll send an activation guide and the codes as soon as you confirm the recipient list. Promo codes will expire 30 days after activation.

We’re excited to support the sprint and will coordinate a short live demo during opening remarks — Laura will follow up on scheduling.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Exec, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: activation_guide.txt (step-by-step for redeeming codes)
